A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the node copying method of partially persistent data structures with constant update time is optimal in the worst case.
the node copying method of [Driscoll et al., 1991] can be extended to partially persistent data structures with worst case constant update time, and that this is asymptotically optimal.
